time_contract: CSV time is OPEN; H4 decision=open+4h; entry=exact M5 open at decision

indicator_contract.ema: MT5-compatible SMA seed over the first period, followed by recursive EMA with alpha=2/(period+1)
indicator_contract.atr: MT5/Wilder ATR with SMA true-range seed followed by Wilder recursion

rules.touch: Use the first valid later H4 EMA20 touch whose wick stays on the trend side of EMA200
rules.invalid_touch: If an EMA20-touch candle wicks through EMA200 but closes back on the valid side, discard only that basis candle and wait for the next valid EMA20 touch
rules.pre_entry_invalidation_only: Before entry, H4 close beyond EMA200 or EMA20 recrossing EMA200 cancels the setup and skips entry
rules.post_entry_ema200_policy: After entry, EMA200 is not an exit and does not move the stop
rules.trigger: any later H4 close beyond the selected valid-touch bar high/low; no bar expiry
rules.one_shot: first completed setup only per EMA cross
rules.stop_anchor: For LONG use the lower of valid-touch low and EMA200; for SHORT use the higher of valid-touch high and EMA200
rules.stop_buffer: max($30, 0.1*ATR14 on the valid-touch H4 bar)
rules.target: causally confirmed left-side H4 swing levels
rules.target_filter: skip levels until net >=50 pips and RR>=1
rules.partial: 50% at TP1; remaining stop to net break-even; rest at next farther swing
rules.same_m5_order: SL first before TP1; break-even first after TP1
